mapper.select: SELECT t.topic_id, t.title, t.banner, t.announcement, t.reward_text, t.join_steps, t.requirements, t.judge_rule, t.start_time, t.end_time, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_story_topic st JOIN zhw_story s ON s.story_id = st.story_id AND s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' WHERE st.topic_id = t.topic_id) AS story_count FROM zhw_topic t WHERE t.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

SELECT t.topic_id, t.title, t.banner, t.announcement, t.reward_text, t.join_steps, t.requirements, t.judge_rule, t.start_time, t.end_time, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_story_topic st JOIN zhw_story s ON s.story_id = st.story_id AND s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' WHERE st.topic_id = t.topic_id) AS story_count FROM zhw_topic t WHERE t.topic_id = #{topicId} AND t.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zhw_topic (title, banner, announcement, reward_text, join_steps, requirements, judge_rule, start_time, end_time, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{banner}, #{announcement}, #{rewardText}, #{joinSteps}, #{requirements}, #{judgeRule}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, '0', '0', #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE zhw_topic SET del_flag = '2' WHERE topic_id = #{topicId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO zhw_story_topic (story_id, topic_id, create_time) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{topicId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM zhw_story_topic WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND topic_id = #{topicId}
mapper.select:
SELECT s.story_id, s.title, s.cover, s.setting_content, s.user_id, s.view_count, s.like_count, s.comment_count, s.branch_count, s.participant_count, s.heat_score, s.status, s.del_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, u.nick_name AS author_nick_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, IF(#{currentUserId} > 0, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_like l WHERE l.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND l.target_id = s.story_id AND l.target_type = 0), 0) AS liked, IF(#{currentUserId} > 0, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_mark m WHERE m.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND m.story_id = s.story_id AND m.branch_id = 0), 0) AS marked FROM zhw_story s JOIN zhw_story_topic st ON st.story_id = s.story_id AND st.topic_id = #{topicId} LEFT JOIN zhw_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0'
ORDER BY s.heat_score DESC
ORDER BY s.update_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_topic WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '0'
SELECT t.title FROM zhw_topic t JOIN zhw_story_topic st ON st.topic_id = t.topic_id WHERE st.story_id = #{storyId} AND t.del_flag = '0'
